Rewards and incentive mechanisms need to be part of the strategy, even though other measures will also have a significant value and position. Hence to develop a communications kit in the beginning of the project, which aims at informing and engaging customers throughout the project is lost cause - and at best a waste of money. Hence the strategy and the tools will continue development as part of the interaction with the community and a final documentation of the tools being used and their impact ratio will be ready in the end of the project at M42.
